title: S03T04 - Add interrupted-sync recovery, backups, doctor repairs, and observability
description: Make partial transfer, process death, version skew, corrupt manifests, stale locks, and divergence recoverable through explicit snapshots, status, and safe repair commands.
acceptanceCriteria: Every synchronization phase is crash-safe or resumable and records enough state to explain its outcome.
Doctor and console distinguish local dirt, remote divergence, schema skew, conflicts, corruption, and recoverable interruption with exact commands.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
